verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a design tool, so a developer inspect/handoff mode is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows a Claude Code handoff bundle, HTML/PDF/PPTX export and org-scoped share links. Nothing documents per-layer inspection, measurements, style or asset extraction, CSS/iOS/Android code snippets, or view-only developer access without an editor seat, and the handoff bundle is a different feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat
